newsitem.title: GERMANY: Netanyahu to visit Bonn next week.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu to visit Bonn next week.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu will meet German Chancellor Helmut Kohl on September 26 for talks on the Middle East peace proces and bilateral relations, a German government spokesman said on Monday.

The visit will be Netanyahu's first to Germany since his election last June. Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy visited Bonn last week, and Palestinian President Yasser Arafat is due in Frankfurt and Bonn later this week.
